criteria.rationale: Verified: the topological first commit is always one of the input heads that no other input head descends from; sealed bundles are never recomputed (all Head consumers compare the stored value); the bundle digest excludes Head. Unresolved/accepted: divergent heads (R1-F2), silent fallback (R1-F4), no multi-set wiring test (R1-F3), governed files changed after the head (spec non-goal with recorded follow-up).
The change adds one read-only, bounded git call through captureGovernanceGit inside bundle preparation; no shared state, goroutines or lifecycle changed.
Bundle schema unchanged; Subject.Head is cleared from the payload digest (review_bundle.go:1965), so bundle identity is unaffected; only new multi-set bundles carry a different advisory head.
Unknown head and single head return empty and fall back (test lines 29-34); output is accepted only if it is a full 40-hex object id. Missing '--'/pre-validation tracked as R1-F1 (low).

Milestone/roadmap bundle and dispatch suites pass on the sealed run; the dispatch consumes Subject.Head as the sealed commit (review_dispatch.go:543), which now contains every member's commits for linear histories.
The chosen head is recorded in the bundle and printed in the brief range; the silent fallback lacks a reason (R1-F4, low, carried).
Examined the bundle digest canonicalisation and every Head consumer; no CLI/MCP/file format change, sealed bundles keep their recorded head, spec scopes (single change set) are unchanged.
Test covers three orderings, duplicate heads and an unknown head; read the code and found the selection sound for linear and divergent histories.

Cause: subject.Head assigned per loop iteration over id-sorted sets (review_bundle.go:791) made the sealed commit arbitrary; D1 replaces it with the topological maximum, which does not depend on timestamps (same-second commits tie on date), so the sealed worktree (review_dispatch.go:543) contains every member's commits.
Changelog entry (fixed, non-breaking) and spec Known gaps/Residual risks match the runtime behaviour I read; no operator docs describe the head choice.
Removes the 'sealed checkout inputs differ'/'no sealed review bundle' failures caused by an old sealed commit; residual silent fallback is R1-F4 (low).
R1 tested directly; R2 wiring verified by reading review_bundle.go:783-794, test gap tracked as R1-F3 (low).

Compared the diff with the spec artifacts list: only review_bundle.go, the new test, the matrix entry, start and changelog changed, matching the declared artifacts; Base selection left untouched (N1).

Examined the new git invocation: arguments come from the governed delivery-integrity index, run via gitCommand with no shell; rev-list has no write-capable options and the output is validated as a full object id. Hardening (pre-validation and '--') tracked as R1-F1 (low).

Compared with sorting by commit date (rejected in D1 because same-second commits tie); one helper and a single git call, skipped for single-head scopes; no speculative extension. The choice would be invalidated if the sets' heads routinely diverge (merge workflows), see R1-F2.
